replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
The paths look far too narrow, and people can easily camp spawn by knocking people out.
The middle should be bigger.
replies.body_tagged:

replies.author: HereIwas
replies.body:
Besides, the map is too small for a huge game like CTH.
I won't really say that CTH is a really big game, but it is not big enough to fill in this map. So I would suggest you to change the whole map into a bigger one with new ideas.
